actions.source: Exact current or historical Run identity.
actions.guard: Opening history does not activate or mutate the current Scenario/draft.

actions.action: Run again from a stale current result
actions.source: No source Run input is substituted; action builds the request from the current working plan.
actions.guard: Explicit user action; no automatic rerun.

actions.source: The selected Run's exact retained canonical_input_snapshot.request.
actions.destination: New Run with a new ID, same source Scenario/Version context, and normal lifecycle.
actions.guard: Disabled/rejected when exact request is missing, dataset is not active, or Run type is unsupported.
actions.compute: Recomputes from the historical request; does not replace current result association or mutate current plan/map state.

actions.source: Current successful Optimization Run and selected public solution.
actions.destination: Create a new Version or create a branch.
actions.guard: Confirmation names source Scenario/Version/Run/solution and destination. Requires retained source Version and compatible dataset.
actions.compute: Does not rerank or change Pareto membership; resulting plan requires a fresh RF Run.

actions.source: Exact selected historical Run and public solution ID.
actions.destination: New Version or new branch from the exact source Scenario/Version.
actions.guard: Confirmation names both source and destination; disabled when exact source Version or dataset is unavailable.
actions.compute: Does not substitute current optimization state or current priorities.

actions.source: Exact historical Run and retained source ScenarioRevision.
actions.destination: New Report bound to that ScenarioRevision/Run.
actions.guard: Confirmation names source Scenario/Version/Run and current workspace. Action is unavailable if exact source Version is not retained.

actions.action: Generate Report from current unsaved plan
actions.source: Current working plan; explicitly called Current unsaved plan when not tied to immutable Version.
actions.destination: Report without inventing a saved Version binding.
actions.guard: Show that the Report was not tied to a saved Version.
actions.compute: Report generation only; no implicit RF rerun.

actions.action: Save Version while a result is stale
actions.guard: Copy states that the current plan is saved and the stale Run remains tied to the input that produced it.
actions.compute: Does not attach the stale Run to the new Version.

actions.source: Selected Report bytes and preserved source metadata.
actions.guard: Disabled if bytes are missing/unreadable; regenerating is a separate explicit action.

actions.destination: Source Scenario Version inspector, focused on that exact Version while the active Version plan remains unchanged.
actions.guard: The exact source revision must still be retained. If it is missing, keep the user in history/report context and explain UNAVAILABLE. If navigation would discard an unsaved draft, block the Scenario switch and keep the draft until the user saves it as a Version.

invariants: No stale map overlay is restored to look current.
No action silently switches the current draft to a historical source.
Scenario navigation is blocked before it can discard an unsaved draft.
Opening a source Version inspects that exact revision; Continue from Version remains the separate draft-changing action.
Run and Report identities/source bindings are not rewritten.
Missing data is UNAVAILABLE, not UNSUPPORTED.
